source_state: uncommitted packed Metal workspace implementation and selected-row affine companion promotion

native_runtime.patches: safemlx-sys/src/mlx-c/patches at the recorded source revision

coverage.dimensions: F32/F16/BF16; contiguous and strided operands; vector, batched, final-position/tied and sequence projections; strict and zero-sentinel lookup; affine split-K and second reduction pass; FP8 partial blocks and activation quantization

derivation: Capacity uses exact selected Metal page rounding and bounded oversized cache reuse; all candidate temporary allocations remain charged through completion, without relying on donation.
Affine projection includes input/companion promotion, contiguous copies, packed storage compaction, output and optional bias arithmetic. MXFP4 has native U8 scales and retains activation dtype.

Quantized split-K targets 512 threadgroups with 32-by-32 tiles, bounded by quantization groups and exact divisibility; a reduction above 256 partials and below 1024 output blocks adds 32 partial outputs. Group-16 always selects QMV. Cold bounds take the minimum QMV/QMM threshold across supported GPU generations.

Affine/MXFP4 embeddings gather only selected packed rows and companions, then dequantize and restore F32. Mixed affine companion types promote after gathering; promotion and compaction cannot both add independent copies because gathered and cast outputs are contiguous.

GGML custom projection and lookup decode weights directly, including possible input/weight compaction and output shape copies. Compiled codebooks are JIT program constants outside the per-call host payload domain.

FP8 projection includes U8 activation quantization and F32 block scales, packed weights, native scale expansion, input compaction, and output dtype/shape restoration. UE8M0 uses a 256-entry F32 lookup with 1024 host bytes plus separately priced native copy, indices and decoded scales.
Host facts are explicit for each supported format. Borrowed preparation payloads, retained state and parameters, capture factories and transport require disjoint enclosing quotes.

numerical_method.oracle: Manually packed affine/MXFP4 with independent scalar decoding, canonical eredu-gguf GGML decoding (pinned llama-c0bc8591 IQ raw blocks for first little-endian rows), manually decoded E4M3 weights with exact activation quantization; F64 dot products and scalar row selection.
numerical_method.distinct_ggml_rows: Per-row finite half scales; IQ1M uses its distributed scale nibbles. Every row differs from the first, checked independently before native dispatch.
numerical_method.projection_tolerance: 0.03 + 0.02 * abs(F64 reference), plus independently computed low-precision QMM rounding allowance only where applicable.
numerical_method.rounding_allowance: For 512-column F16/BF16 affine/MXFP4 QMM fixtures, independently rounded decoded weights and F64 group dots are evaluated over legal split counts and up to eight cyclic reduction lanes. Each partial and each reduction addition rounds to the activation dtype; maximum deviation from the F64 canonical dot is retained. Fused/separate affine arithmetic is included. F32, GGML and FP8 receive no such allowance.
numerical_method.embedding_tolerance: 0.002 + 0.01 * abs(reference); every output compared and required finite.
numerical_method.fp8_activations: Each 128-column activation block includes 448 and otherwise exactly represented small integers, making quantization scale one including partial blocks.

measurement_scope: Parameters and input views are evaluated and synchronized before recording active-memory baseline and resetting the native peak. Execute one operation, evaluate its result and synchronize, then compare peak minus baseline with the cold tensor bound. Host oracle conversion happens afterwards. Prepared inputs, parameter residency and allocator cache are outside this incremental operation measurement; separate host charges are source-derived rather than inferred from GPU counters.

limitations: These are equation mechanism bounds and selected native operator measurements, not production whole-request budget enforcement.

Request preparation, materialization/residency, shared concurrent reservations, decode resources, media/speculation/observations/snapshots and parallel transport remain to be fully composed and wired.
Only the Apple M3 Ultra Metal realization is measured. NAX-specific selection has source bounds but no native hardware run here; CUDA and CPU fallback are not certified by these facts.
Ordinary block-FP8 embedding is not selected by its factory; separately declared grouped/hyper projections and remaining operations need their own facts. Unknown required domains remain unknown.

Managed tensor and explicit host payload bounds do not cover cached allocator residency, driver/JIT/metadata or total process memory. No new released-checkpoint or process peak measurements are included.
